notes.title: Patch Notes (2025-09-12)
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Controller input type now persists between levels.
[*]Default look sensitivity is decreased and sensitivity range is lower.
[*]Walk speed in apartment is decreased.
[/list]

notes.title: Snooze: A Choice is complete and ready for release!
notes.content: [p]Good news, everyone! Snooze is now feature complete and ready for release. It's been a long road, and, being my first game, that road had a lot of bumps. But I hope I've created something fun for y'all, and I'm super excited to start building something new. Thank you again for all the support![/p]
